name: Twelve Permissions #06 — THREE ABANDONED
description: TO FAIL OUT LOUD AND KEEP COUNT. A game. Calculators for government contractors. Self-help books. All three built, all three dead inside a month. Not one of them failed because the code did not work. They failed because nobody wanted them, which was a distinction I had not understood until I paid for it three times. Evidence: Three ventures between 6 and 14 July 2026, none of them still running.
